title: Verify 182 additional P104 native frame maps (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independently qualifies 182 previously uncovered ordered native frame maps from [PR #5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545) head `18968423711fd902aaee1099979497d55603e1dc`, including all 11 private returns. Combined with the retained receipts in [PR #5548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5548)/[PR #5550](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5550), this covers 224/2981 pairs and 254/3624 local paid occurrences. The residual is explicitly 2757 public rank 1–3 pairs and 3370 paid occurrences. This is an exact finite native audit, with a conditional all-width interpretation under the retained framework. The paid profile and κ are unchanged; no full parent admission is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Base `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; publication `998d312fc3af584d39a3cf4c10a45e02a8395f48`. Scope is refined from the scalar-to-moment research task to a missing native verification layer. This complements [PR5548](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5548) and [PR5550](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5550), now merged. [PR #5551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5551)'s later four-new-map audit concerns its changed map universe and does not duplicate these 182 predecessor maps. This package does not certify automatic transfer to [PR #5551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5551), [PR #5561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5561) or successors. The current upstream review prioritizes those stronger constructions before assigning further old-head residual work.

## Validation

Python 3.12/stdlib. Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-native-subset-independent-audit`.

The original exact normal/-O pair passed in 24.449 s, sampled 86.71 MiB, with complete result SHA256 `fa2fe7ce93e72569f611ca810f440e6b77d92221350c51b7b6ab19ca34d6c64b`. The portable registered pair passed in 26.494 s, sampled 115.93 MiB, under the 150 s / 512 MiB guard. A separate Git-free read-only export with spaces in its path passed in 8.350 s, sampled 89.54 MiB, with empty PATH. All frozen package/export bytes remained unchanged. Metadata, source-history and exact remote-commit byte preflight passed for 41 package/input files.

Checks compare the actual native recipe against all 18 signed Pauli images and an independent exact dense column. Thirteen scoped controls comprise 10 operator/authentication faults and 3 structural sanity checks; they are not 13 complete source mutations. Static wrapper corruption/symlink/extra-file tests reject before scientific launch. Hosted CI is pending at submission. Independent human/formal acceptance, the residual low-rank maps, uniform precision/tape/stock and complete compiler/outer funding were not newly established.

## Credit

Ali Romman for the P104 construction and [PR #5544](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5544)/[PR #5545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5545); Gareth Davidson, David Arias, Cinna Davis, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan and retained native/controller/geometry/tensor/compiler contributors. Credit thu-nmrc's separate successor audit. New independent qualification/publication for Chris R/Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0 and source provenance retained.

## Open next questions

Rebind any reused map evidence to literal frame bytes, actual recipe and occurrences on the strongest current construction before further native work. Assess [PR #5561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5561)/[PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569) and the overlapping [PR #5567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5567) endpoint audit first. A separate frozen budget and nomination are required for any remaining old-head rank band. Native coverage does not improve economics or fund κ.
